(c) The exact wording of the Error message for each individual failure mode: this constraint is not directly specified in the provided materials. Please refer to the core source files under src/server/ for authoritative implementation details, particularly validateHook.js, normalizeArgs.js, registerHooks.js, and colorGenerator.js. answer: Three points, three answers. (a) Windows: the result is exactly { file: process.env.comspec || 'cmd.exe', args: ['/s', '/c', '"<command>"'], options: { windowsVerbatimArguments: true } }. The command is wrapped in double quotes verbatim — the format does not vary with the command string content. The one conditional: if a comspec value is supplied via the request it replaces cmd.exe; otherwise cmd.exe stands. Output JSON key order is file, args, options. (b) Unix-like: on any platform other than win32 the result is exactly { file: '/bin/sh', args: ['-c', '<command>'], options: {} }. The options map is an empty object — nothing else. Key order is file, args, options. (c) Detection: the function branches on process.platform === 'win32' — it is not a function parameter and not an env-based mode switch. The comspec environment variable only affects the file value on the Windows branch, never the branch selection itself. Too many questions. answer: Three points, three answers. (a) The palette in src/server/logPrinter/colors.js is exactly [chalk.yellow, chalk.cyan, chalk.green, chalk.magenta], in that order. Entries are chalk colorizer functions (chalk method references), not bare color name strings and not pre-baked ANSI codes. (b) Yes — it is an infinite ES6 generator (*cycleColor). It holds a currentIndex counter starting at 0; when currentIndex >= colors.length it resets to 0 before yielding; each call to gen.next().value returns the color at currentIndex then increments it. So it wraps and repeats through the palette forever, starting from the first entry, chalk.yellow. (c) The exact output line format of the log/logError/logStart/logExit wrappers, including any prefix/suffix: this constraint is not directly specified in the provided materials.
